rationale: Closing handoff for this run, updated with the two witnesses accepted since the earlier summary. Everything listed below was produced by a fixed artifact executed by the trusted runner and reviewed with no open issue; the single holds entry is the bounded negative on the overlap window. No map object changes, no new evidence, and no exploration run is offered as evidence.

feedback.answered: Eleven obligations were confirmed by executed and reviewed checks, two of them now with a second witness. Election-term context: a heartbeat-shaped AppendEntries handled on the transport's connection goroutine can publish a current term below one the node already reported adopting, reproduced with a substitute stream layer and over the production TCP transport. Client futures: requests accepted by a leader can go unresolved after the node becomes inactive, and one accepted while leading can remain unresolved after shutdown. Vote record: a node that persisted a vote can persist a second, different vote for the same term after its published term dropped. Leadership: two leaders of one term can hold leadership at the same time, while the overlap-window variant is a bounded negative that holds. Client contract: GetConfiguration reports index zero for a configuration established at index one, and a reported commit index can name an entry the voting quorum does not store. Lease: a leader with a reachable quorum can still step down under the lease check. Commit context: a node installing a snapshot at index 43 publishes commit_index 0 while applied and last are 43, reproduced with the receiver's log left intact and again with the receiver configured to truncate its log at the snapshot index, and the same under-report occurs after a restart that restores the node's own snapshot. Verification: VerifyLeader reports success when the only reachable acknowledgements besides the leader's own vote come from non-voters, reproduced with one non-voter against two voters and with two non-voters against three voters.
remaining: Repair locations are open for the whole set and no source names the intended layer: serialising the heartbeat callback or making the handler concurrency-safe; completing or rejecting accepted futures; filtering verification votes by suffrage or excluding non-voter replication states.
No consumer outside the module was exercised for the client-contract findings, so their downstream consequence is argued from documented contracts rather than observed.
The campaign path of a server that holds no vote is not fully read, even though the voter-side refusal guard for a non-voter candidate is explicit and located.
The transfer path accepts a non-voter as a target and reported success while no leader of either kind was established, which two exploration prefixes recorded and no obligation covers.

Deferred or unread: third-party SetHeartbeatHandler transports, the MonotonicLogStore and snapshot-compaction interplay, the nested fuzzy and raft-compat modules, and mixed configurations with both reachable voters and reachable non-voters.
The commit-context witnesses do not include the post-install log range, so the truncation itself is not directly witnessed in the second scenario; the judged value does not depend on it.
feedback.rationale: This is the compact close of the run: the confirmed responsibilities with an executed witness for each and the concrete open items, so a later run can go straight to the unread paths or the repair questions. The update over the earlier summary is the two additional witnesses accepted since it - the truncated-log variant of the commit-context finding and the two-non-voter variant of the verification finding - and the sharply stated remaining limits.
